import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
pipe_od = 25     # 管外径 (mm)
pipe_id = 20     # 管内径 (mm)
bend_r = 40      # 弯曲半径 (mm)

# === 建模 ===
# 弯曲路径（90度弧线）
path = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .radiusArc((bend_r, bend_r), -bend_r)
)

# 外管
outer = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(pipe_od / 2)
    .sweep(path)
)

# 内孔
inner = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(pipe_id / 2)
    .sweep(path)
)

result = outer.cut(inner)

show_object(result)
